colors.description: Dark mode emphasizes deep obsidian/midnight tones with champagne gold accents to highlight gemstone brilliance. Light mode uses pearl white with stark contrasting deep tones to ensure institutional credibility.

headings.description: A high-end editorial serif. Use for all display text, hero sections, and elegant catalog names. Tracking MUST be tight (-tracking-tighter) on large sizes.

body.description: A clean, modern geometric sans-serif for high readability in dense data (lab certificates, admin dashboard, verification portal).

rules: No generic fonts (Inter, Space Grotesk, Roboto) allowed.
H1 sizes fluid: text-5xl md:text-6xl+, tracking-tighter.
Uppercase labels must use extreme tracking: tracking-[0.2em] text-xs.
Maintain a 2-step tailwind scale gap between H1 and subtitles.

marketing.hero: Asymmetrical layout, full-screen background with deep contrast gradients overlay (bg-black/40). Never centered generic text. Include subtle grain texture.
marketing.bento_grid: For catalog showcasing: md:grid-cols-12, wide gaps (gap-8), overlapping elements. E.g., Col-span-8 for hero gem, col-span-4 for lab details.
marketing.spacing: Extremely generous padding. Use p-8, p-12, p-16, p-24 for section breathing room.

dashboard_and_verification.surfaces: Flat solid background with 1px delicate borders (border-white/10 or border-black/10). No muddy shadows. Use sharp edges.
dashboard_and_verification.spacing: Tight, efficient (p-4 to p-8), ensuring data visibility.

cards.marketing: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 (dark mode) or bg-black/5 (light mode). Must have 1px inner border. Ambient shadow-2xl.
cards.dashboard: Neumorphism/Flat with 1px crisp borders. Minimal radius (rounded-sm or rounded-none).

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for Catalog/WhatsApp CTA. Hover: slight lift, increased glow.
buttons.states: Hover MUST have explicit text and background colors defined. Never rely on inheritance.

navigation.style: Sticky Crystal Glass header. Never fully transparent if content scrolls behind. Include language switcher (ID/EN).

verification_portal.style: Technical/Swiss Brutalist approach nested in luxury context. Stark contrast, mono-spaced numbers for cert IDs, clear QR scanner UI box.

motion.transitions: Slow, cinematic eases. Use transition-all duration-500 ease-out for hover states.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis for a weighty, premium feel.
motion.interactions: Subtle scale-up (scale-105) on gemstone imagery. Reveal text via mask-image animations.

icons_and_assets.usage: Use thin, elegant weights. Avoid blocky icons.

gemstones.description: Macro shot of purple crystals. Use for hero or abstract aesthetic backgrounds.

jewelry_catalog.description: Luxurious silver diamond ring. Use for jewelry catalog placeholders.
Man holding gold chains. Lifestyle luxury imagery.

lab_verification.description: Close up of a microscope lens. Use for institutional trust / lab verification sections.
Scientists in laboratory. Use for the 'About Us' or 'Certification Process' pages.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure fonts in index.css: Cormorant Garamond (headings) and Outfit (body).
Update tailwind.config.js with the provided color scheme, utilizing HSL variables for dark/light mode toggling.
Implement the landing page with absolute luxury focus: extreme whitespace, large serif typography, and glassmorphic cards.
Build the Verification Portal with a technical, high-contrast UI layout mimicking physical secure documents.
Build a bilingual toggle (Indonesian / English) in the navigation.
Admin Dashboard must remain functional but inherit the dark/light premium aesthetic (sharp borders, Outfit font).
Do NOT use pure #000 or #FFF anywhere except where explicit contrast requires it. Use the tinted themes.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use centered generic text alignment.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons.
Add micro-animations for hover states and entrances.
Do not use generic border-radii; align with the luxury brand (sharp or pill).
Prioritize Shadcn/UI for dashboard functionality but use pure HTML/Tailwind for marketing asymmetry.
